faq.a1: Sihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo yengqondo eziphelele okuhlanganisa ukwelapha komuntu ngamunye, ukweluleka kwamaqembu, ukwelapha komndeni, ukululama emuveni kokulimala, nezinhlelo zokupholisa emphakathini.
faq.a2: Ungahlela iseshini ngekhasimende lethu lokuxhumana, usishayele ngqo, noma uchofoze 'Hlela Iseshini' kuphrofayili yochwepheshe wethu.
faq.a3: Yebo! Sinikezela ngokweluleka kwamahhala, izifundo zomphakathi, namaqembu okweseka. Izinhlelo zethu zokupha ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kufinyeleleka kubo bonke.
faq.a4: Iminikelo inganikelwa ngeBhodi Labaxhasi lethu noma ngokuxhumana nathi ngqo.
faq.a5: Nakanjani! Sinamathuba okuvolontiya nge-virtual okuhlanganisa ukweseka kwezintanga ku-inthanethi, ukwakha okuqukethwe, nemikhankazo yokuqoqa izimali.
faq.a6: Yebo. Lonke ulwazi lwamakhasimende luyimfihlo ngokuqinile futhi luvikelwe ngaphansi kwezimiso ze-HIPAA namazinga okugcina imfihlo akazwelonke.
faq.a7: Sisebenza nabahlinzeki bomshwalense abahlukene. Sicela uxhumane nathi ngeiningizimu yakho yomshwalense ukuze sikusize ukuqinisekisa ukumbozwa kwakho.
faq.a8: Samukela ubambiswano nezikole, amabhizinisi, nezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo. Xhumana nathi ngekhasimende lethu lokuxhumana ukuxoxa ngamathuba okubambisana.
faq.a9: Ezimweni eziphuthumayo ezisongela impilo, sicela ushayele i-SADAG Suicide Crisis Line ku-0800 567 567 (izinsuku zonke, 24/7), noma ushayele u-10111 (SAPS) / 10177 (i-ambulense). Ithimba lethu lingakuxhumanisa nezinsizakalo zezinkinga ngezikhathi zokusebenza.
faq.a10: Sisebenzisana namabhizinisi, izikole, ama-NGO nomnyango kahulumeni ezinhlelweni zempilo, uxhaso, nokufinyelela emphakathini. Vakashela ikhasi lethu Le-Partnerships noma uthumele umyalezo ku-info@worldchangersmh.org.
faq.a11: Yebo. I-World Changers iyi-NPO/PBO ebhalisiwe, ngakho abanikeli baseNingizimu Afrika bangacela isitifiketi sentela ye-Section 18A. Thumela i-imeyili ku-info@worldchangersmh.org emva kokunikela.
faq.q12: Ngingaluthola kanjani usizo uma ngingakwazi ukulukhokhela?
faq.a12: Akekho oxoshwayo ngenxa yezimo zezimali. Sinikela ngokwelulekwa kwamahhala, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezisekelwe. Sicela usithinte.
